text:
Maya P: Hi team — quick Q. I'm on unpaid parental leave and need to add my adult sibling (disabled, on SSI) as a dependent. Their SSN is pending (app filed), and I need coverage retroactive to their placement date. Can we do a QLE retro add and how does payroll/proration work while I'm on leave?

Dylan: Congrats on the placement, Maya. Short answer: yes, usually we can backdate to the placement date if you submit proof within the 30-day QLE window. But unpaid leave can change payroll deductions — will check specifics.

Maya P: Thanks. The sibling has an SSA disability letter + SSI award letter, but SSN confirmation will take weeks. Is the SSA letter enough to prove eligibility now? Also want to understand if we can get premiums refunded for prior pay periods.

Samir: Hi @Maya P — from benefits side: SSA disability letter + SSI award letter are acceptable evidence for dependent eligibility, but we also need documentation of legal relationship or guardianship/POA if applicable. If SSN is delayed, we can still enroll and mark SSN pending; final SSN must be provided once available.

Samir: For retro coverage: we can backdate to placement date if you submit docs within the 30-day QLE window. If you're outside that window, we may need a benefits exceptions review. Refunds for prior payroll deductions are possible only if deductions were taken and we can show coverage should have been in effect; since you're on unpaid leave there may be zero/limited payroll deductions — benefits premiums can still be billed retroactively.

Maya P: So next steps I should upload: 1) SSA disability letter, 2) SSI award letter, 3) placement paperwork, 4) guardianship/POA if you need it, 5) SSN when available. Upload where?

Samir: Exactly. Please upload to our secure People Ops portal: https://benefits.redwood.example/upload — choose "Dependent QLE" and mark SSN as "pending" in the form. In the comments, add placement date and payroll status (on unpaid leave).

Dylan: FYI payroll/proration: if you have no active pay during the retro period, Benefits will invoice you for employee-share premiums retroactively unless you choose to have the cost come from a future paycheck after return. People Ops can help arrange a repayment plan.

Maya P: Ok noted. One more: what about medical accommodation for complex needs — can I request case management and prior auth help during the retro period?

Samir: Yes — once enrolled, case management can be initiated back to the effective date. For prior auths, the carrier typically honors retro coverage effective date for services rendered after that date. We'll loop in our benefits advocate after enrollment to manage authorizations.

People Ops Bot: Reminder: QLE documentation must be uploaded within 30 days from placement date for automatic backdating. Exceptions require review. See policy: https://handbook.redwood.example/benefits/qle-policy

Maya P: Great, I'll upload the docs today. If I hit a problem with SSN timing, who do I ping?

Samir: Ping me or @People Ops and put "SSN pending" in the upload comments. We'll temporarily enroll and send instructions for SSN follow-up. Bring any carrier correspondence to Samir (cc: benefits@redwood.example). :thumbsup:

Dylan: If you want help filling the portal form I can walk through it — quick screenshare later today?

Maya P: That would be awesome, thanks both. I'll DM for a time.

Samir: Thanks — we'll get this squared away.
